create_uniform_binning_tokenizer: create a UniformBinningTokenizer instance with num_bins, data_min, data_max, and stats parameters
create_tokenizer_from_dataset: create a UniformBinningTokenizer from a training dataset using the create class method with a key and num_bins
encode_trajectory: encode a 3D trajectory tensor into one-hot tokenized bins using the UniformBinningTokenizer encode method
decode_trajectory: decode a 4D one-hot tokenized trajectory tensor back to continuous values using the decode method
check_discrete_property: check the discrete property of UniformBinningTokenizer to confirm it returns True for discrete tokenization
